# Empty-basis first studies

These four archives preserve the complete original external packets before the
next finite empty-basis changes. They are informed authoring studies, not a blind
benchmark. Every original source, desired draft, prediction, mistake, context,
runner, request record and raw stream is retained without repair. No source or
observation from these packets replaces the existing stdlib-boundary history.

| Packet | Original files | Original bytes | Archive SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |

| `wrapper-first-observations.tar.gz` | 22 | 189,935 | `3aa859a842fe866fb7097e04a0a3a9773997e43875a2611f8f33c0d527c3c09f` |
| `finite-first-sources.tar.gz` | 38 | 23,171 | `4a505b95ea6bba4372c425b3486d57feb5ea3761e8df03636311926fc8210bca` |
| `finite-first-observations.tar.gz` | 95 | 9,482,686 | `13734a93c9e307c903635b3caf739f0a672ac83772a55f5f582b6e10d0e79b2e` |

The total is **173 original files / 9,702,727 expanded bytes**, stored in
1,509,375 compressed bytes. [The complete manifest](packets.json) records every
original relative path, byte count, SHA-256 and mode, plus compressed and raw
tar identities. All original file modes are `0644`. Each deterministic gzip
contains ordered regular-only USTAR entries with mode `0644`, empty user/group
names, and zero uid, gid and timestamp. Container metadata is retention metadata,
not a historical Git archive baseline or authentication of authorship.

The wrapper source freeze is
`20561f43662a2c6e7aef9c837cf208878d561cb3cfc5311966da8cfca188feb7`.
Four cases each retain desired and current complete projects: eight projects,
sixteen source/manifest files, the README and freeze. Desired forms remain
uncompiled. Four actual selected checks retain **1 acceptance / 3 refusals**:
both `empty_bits()` calls inside classical wrappers receive type refusals;
the Unit wrapper with an unused helper passes; selecting its CoherentLift helper
receives the separate unsupported materialization diagnostic. The original
predictions and complete before/after records remain intact.

The finite first-source freeze is
`02e9f30765722f3301799c04a99fbace24eb99ed9767ddddc0e93cb56177d4a8`.
It lists 37 files / 15,003 bytes; `freeze.json` is the additional 38th file.
Eight cases retain sixteen complete current/desired projects. Seventeen fresh
commands record **4 acceptances / 13 refusals / 0 timeouts**, with no source
repairs, retries or fallback. Desired drafts remain uncompiled. Four finite
register-profile refusals remain distinct from common type/ownership errors;
the unused closed empty-owner sibling retains its finite rejection. Three
selected Raw checks pass. Explicit empty consumption/reintroduction passes the
separately requested hierarchy profile and refuses its separately requested
Raw profile. Authored programs use at most one physical qubit; no maximum-size
case was generated or checked.

The finite capture freeze is
`bb9e2fbeb22907606300fd929d62bd6729bff70ea0ee339e3b4e57c80814fc3e`.
It lists 94 files / 9,464,404 bytes; `capture-freeze.json` is the additional
95th file. It preserves the separately frozen runner, all seventeen literal
commands and raw streams, durations, classifications, per-invocation contexts,
complete working-input maps and final analysis. The maps record 18,961 files
and the unchanged observation digest
`1c12213ae701e3150fd76872b90dc6e88259333b41b1adf122fd33399f4036dd`.
That is an observed dirty-source identity, not a binary/source correspondence
proof. The finite study observed HEAD
`54edaa7717777ac35f86d7a4a9d013069ad676ac`; the earlier wrapper study separately
observed `a599d50c4a6f882339c76bc114a90fe7146c62ed`.

Both studies used the immutable prior PR394 candidate CLI bytes
`fb76379c81758517cc12e2b992e9855cdbbfa5c4c2768887f772d649a35b347c`
and the selected kernel bytes
`54c9d60b80f67217abd95c8fe6ec1c06aa262e142d5e6db30f46a20cb90faf07`.
The prior CLI was not built from the finite study's current dirty source.
Native JSON checker_identity is unpinned; recorded byte observations are not
trusted build attestation. Raw successes report `source_steps_checked=true`,
`source_meaning_verified=false` and `source_preservation_verified=false`.
The hierarchy success reports a producer-origin composition request and
producer-consistency scope, not an independent requested Meaning.
No source-preservation, PR, quantitative RS or EXACT discharge is claimed.
The two scoped QLV1 guarantees retain their existing scope and premises; all
four broader/supplemental interpretation duties remain pending. Retention does
not complete a feature, Issue, general theorem, release or constitutional act.

Run `python3 -B scripts/test_empty_basis_first.py` from the repository root.
It checks bounded gzip/USTAR containers, the complete byte/mode inventories,
historical freezes, stream bindings, schemas, observation counts and disclosures.
It rejects duplicate, nonregular, unsafe-path and hidden PAX/GNU entries before
tarfile parses members. It never executes recorded commands. No member is
extracted to disk, and retained runners are never imported or executed. These
static identity checks establish neither provenance authenticity nor program
meaning. New compiler/native checks require separately authored commands and
separately recorded current source/binary identities.
